$comment: Group overview tab: segments, intercompany eliminations, EBITDA, forecast, alerts and the office scorecard. Restart the server after editing.

segments.$comment: dimension: office category dimension (config/dashboard-categories.json) whose categories are the segments, e.g. the Company type groups set on the Entities page.

intercompany.$comment: Amounts companies in the group charge each other (management fees, rent to the group's own real estate companies). QuickBooks P&L lines do not say who the other party is, so each rule names the accounts on both sides: income = the receiving company's accounts, expense = the paying company's. segments limits a side to companies in those segments ([] = any company). accounts is a case-insensitive regex on the account name or its full path. Consolidated figures remove both sides; any difference between them is shown so it can be fixed in the books.

ebitda.$comment: EBITDA = net income + these expense accounts added back (interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization). Regex on account name or full path, expense groups only.

forecast.$comment: Full-year outlook for the year of the To month. seasonal: remaining months follow last year's shape scaled by this year's run vs last year (falls back to runRate when last year is missing). runRate: average of the last runRateMonths months.

alerts.$comment: Flags in the Group overview. spikePts: a cost category's share of revenue in the latest month is this many percentage points above its trailing-average (trailingMonths). minSharePct: ignore categories below this share. revenueDropPct: latest month revenue down this much vs the same month last year. lossStreakMonths: consecutive loss-making months. overTarget: flag categories above their target in config/category-view.json over the selected range.

scorecard.$comment: Office scorecard columns and default sort. Keys: revenue | revenueGrowth | netMargin | ebitda | ebitdaMargin | targetsMet.
